summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: No existing watchlist tests. I now have enough to write the plan.  ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  **What I found from a read-only audit (no files touched):**  The backend wiring is actually correct as written today: `watchlists.user_id` is the stable account id (not session id), the watchlist route's own auth middleware (`modules/watchlist/handlers.ts:13-21`) correctly resolves the session cookie → user → sets `X-User-Id`, and every handler filters by `eq(watchlists.user_id, userId)`. The login cookie (`arca_session`, 30-day maxAge, `path: /`) is set correctly on
